question: Which theme marked the 55th World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting held in Davos?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Collaboration for the Intelligent Age.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 55th World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting began in Davos with the theme “Collaboration for the Intelligent Age.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Crystal Awards were presented to David Beckham, Diane von Furstenberg, and Riken Yamamoto for contributions to social, environmental, and creative progress.**
 
• 3,000 global leaders from public and private sectors are participating in the five-day event.
 
• Key discussions focus on geopolitical, geo-economic, and technological challenges and opportunities.
 
• Indian delegation, led by Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, highlights economic policies, digital transformation, and state investment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Crystal Awards__

 __
 
• Recognize individuals for advancing impactful causes such as community regeneration, gender equality, and children’s rights.
 
 
 
• Indian Delegation Highlights__
 __
 
• Focus on Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s economic policies and India’s digital architecture.
 
• State leaders like Devendra Fadnavis and N. Chandrababu Naidu promote state-specific investment opportunities.
 
 
 
• World Economic Forum (WEF)__
 
 
• Founded in 1971, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• Serves as a platform for global leaders to discuss pressing issues and promote public-private collaboration.
